'''Soul Wars''' is a [[members]]-only team [[minigame]], a remake of the original {{RSL|Soul Wars}} released in ''RuneScape 2'' on 10 February 2009. In Soul Wars, two opposing teams compete against each other to gather [[soul fragment]]s and offer them to the [[Soul Obelisk]] in order to weaken, and ultimately defeat, each other's Avatars through combat. Each game lasts up to 15 minutes.
